title: Concept: Unsafe deserialization via Assembly.Load (csharp) — review required
description: In csharp, Assembly.Load reconstructs objects from untrusted bytes and lets the payload name the classes that run. A crafted stream can therefore execute code during construction. Use a data-only format, or an explicit allowlist (Assembly.Load_safe), and authenticate the payload before parsing it.
applicability: csharp services that deserialize stored or networked data; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution when the stream is attacker influenced; HIGH severity.
